system.description:
Use this skill while you are [Incapacitated] during a combat scene. The target gains +1 [Fate Point]. 

(Fate 1): If you have reached your Limit for this skill, you may pay this cost to use it again.

(Bonus): You gain +1 [Starting Fate Point].

A special skill that transforms the remaining power into the wavelength of an ally and transfers it to them in a time of distress when their consciousness is about to run out. Only by abandoning oneself can one find a way to float. Houkage's determination overturns the war situation.
